description: Ask the Director for editing advice on the project's CURRENT composition — it NEVER writes your composition (you stay the decider). Async: returns a consultJobId; then wait_job(kind="consult", id=consultJobId, projectId=...) surfaces the advisory envelope (assessment / proposals / principles / plan). `body.mode`: 'advise' = the planner agent (fast, ~30s-2min) returns a `plan` (framing/cuts/captions/graphics intents) as GUIDANCE you re-author from — no grounded scores, nothing to adopt; 'amend' (default) = the full author→judge→refine loop (minutes) returns a graded `assessment` + a fix candidate you ADOPT via select_candidate with its candidateIndex. ('explore' is coming soon → use amend.) `body.intent` = your goal in plain English; optional `body.focus` (editorial|spatial|brand|caption); `body.ifMatch` binds to your current etag. Use advise for a fast directional nudge, amend for a grounded, adoptable fix.

__schema0.description: Plain-English goal — what you're trying to achieve with this edit.

__schema1.description: advise = proposer-only (no render/judge, no grounded assessment); amend (default) = grade the current composition + author the fix for the weakest criterion; explore = ranked slate of diverse directions. All modes are async — poll the returned job.

__schema2.description: Optional criterion to concentrate the advice on.

__schema3.description: Etag of the composition the advice is computed against. Proposals are bound to it; apply a proposal BEFORE any other edit or it will 409.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

name: consult

consultJobId.description: Opaque consult job id; poll it for the advisory result.

status.description: queued = normal; failed = startup failed and the job is already terminal.

streamUrl.description: Relative SSE endpoint to stream this job's events.

title: Consult
